_note: Hand-made clarifications, kept apart from generated data. tools/import-menu.js applies them after the section rules in lib/roles.js on every import, so a re-import never loses them. Keys are dish ids from data/dishes.json. Allowed fields: role, reason, disputed, base, priceEstimated, priceNote, includes, includesNote, photoKey (an existing key in photos.json). An id that no longer exists is reported as a warning.
